title: Sincerity
text: Deeds are valued by intentions, and each person receives according to what they intended.

title: Good Character
text: The most complete believers in faith are those with the best character.

title: Kind Speech
text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

title: Mercy
text: Show mercy to people on earth, and the One above the heavens will show mercy to you.

title: Brotherhood
text: A Muslim is a brother to another Muslim; he does not wrong him or abandon him.

title: Ease
text: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give good news and do not drive people away.

title: No Harm
text: There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm.

title: Cleanliness
text: Purity is half of faith.

title: Truthfulness
text: Truth leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.

title: Patience
text: Whoever remains patient, Allah will grant him patience.

title: Generosity
text: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.

title: Neighbor Rights
text: He is not a believer whose neighbor is not safe from his harm.

title: Gratitude
text: Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah.

title: Best People
text: The best of people are those most beneficial to people.

title: Smiling
text: Your smile to your brother is charity.

title: Modesty
text: Modesty is part of faith.

title: Forgiveness
text: Show mercy, and you will be shown mercy; forgive, and Allah will forgive you.

title: Justice
text: The just will be on pulpits of light on the Day of Resurrection.

title: Consistency
text: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done regularly, even if small.

title: Repentance
text: All children of Adam make mistakes, and the best of those who make mistakes are those who repent.

title: Reliance
text: If you rely upon Allah as He deserves, He will provide for you as He provides for birds.

title: Supplication
text: Supplication is worship.

title: Humility
text: No one humbles himself for Allah except that Allah raises him.

title: Peace
text: Spread peace among yourselves.

title: Helping Others
text: Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother.

title: Control Anger
text: The strong one is not the one who overcomes others by strength, but the one who controls himself when angry.

title: Optimism
text: Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.

title: Trust
text: Return the trust to the one who entrusted you.

title: Family Care
text: The best of you are those who are best to their families.

title: Gentleness
text: Gentleness is not in anything except that it beautifies it.

title: Hope
text: Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me.
